corrections.text: The article places "12 repositories, 728 downloads" and "19 repositories, 29,090 downloads" in quotation marks as Pluto's words. These strings are not verbatim text: they are assembled from the repository and recorded-download columns of a table in Pluto's analysis. The figures themselves match the table.

The article says BleepingComputer reports that "the second-wave flagship scanned clean while it collected 28,412 downloads." In BleepingComputer this sentence is a quotation from the researchers at Pluto Security, and the same sentence appears in Pluto's own analysis; it is Pluto's statement relayed by the outlet.

The article says the sources do not say whether Hugging Face has acted on the other repositories Pluto lists. BleepingComputer reports that Hugging Face disabled access to the flagship model, and that a near-identical copy uploaded on October 25 under the account htt0118 was still live at the time of writing.
